# @cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4)

[LowCode Engine](https://github.com/alibaba/lowcode-engine) materials of
[Vant 4](https://vant-ui.github.io/vant/#/zh-CN/) (`vant` 4.10.2) for **Vue 3**, rendered by
`@cdlab996/lowcode-vue3`.

<!-- Generated by scripts/materials/readme.cjs: edit the script, not this file. -->

## Components

99 components: every component documented by `vant` 4.10.2
has a meta, with the props, events and slots of [its docs](https://vant-ui.github.io/vant/#/zh-CN/),
a snippet and a `docUrl` to its page.

- The metas are generated from the docs of that version (`scripts/materials`,
  see CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository); `vant` is pinned to 4.10.2.
- `tests/meta.test.ts` checks them against the components of that version:
  declared props, handler names, doc links, code generation exports and
  screenshots.
- `screenshots/` holds a thumbnail of every component, rendered from its
  snippet in the designer canvas; components with nothing to show (modals,
  sub-components) use `screenshots/fallback.svg`.

## Usage

The package ships browser builds; the designer loads them through
`assets.json`. The canvas must run Vue 3 with the
`@cdlab996/lowcode-vue3` simulator.

From a CDN (unpkg serves the published `dist`):

```ts
import { injectAssets } from '@alilc/lowcode-plugin-inject'
import type { IPublicModelPluginContext } from '@alilc/lowcode-types'

const editorInit = (ctx: IPublicModelPluginContext) => ({
  async init() {
    const assets = await injectAssets(
      'https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4/dist/assets.json',
    )
    await ctx.material.setAssets(assets)
  },
})
editorInit.pluginName = 'editorInit'
```

From the installed package (`pnpm add @cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4`), serve its `dist`
yourself and pass the imported JSON with your own URLs:

```ts
import assets from '@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4/dist/assets.json'
```

In the designer of this repository, the material is built in; any other
material is added by pasting its `assets.json` URL into the 物料 panel.

## Files

- `dist/index.js`, `dist/index.css`: the components, as
  `window.Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsVant4`
- `dist/meta.js`: the metas, as `window.Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsVant4Meta`
- `dist/assets.json`: the engine assets pointing at the two, with the
  `codegen` manifest
- `dist/screenshots/`: snippet thumbnails

The scripts, the styles and `assets.json` also come minified (`.min`).
`assets.json` of a release:

```json
{
  "version": "<version>",
  "packages": [
    {
      "package": "@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4",
      "version": "<version>",
      "library": "Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsVant4",
      "urls": [
        "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4@<version>/dist/index.css",
        "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4@<version>/dist/index.js"
      ],
      "codegen": {
        "exports": { "...": "component -> export of vant" },
        "styles": ["..."],
        "dependencies": { "vant": "4.10.2" }
      }
    }
  ],
  "components": [
    {
      "exportName": "Cdlab996LowcodeMaterialsVant4Meta",
      "url": "https://unpkg.com/@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4@<version>/dist/meta.js",
      "package": { "npm": "@cdlab996/lowcode-materials-vant4" }
    }
  ],
  "sort": { "groupList": [], "categoryList": [] }
}
```

The `codegen` manifest is what the code generator
(`@cdlab996/lowcode-code-generator`) uses to import the components from
`vant` in generated projects.

## Development

```bash
pnpm -C packages/materials/vant4 build   # dist/
pnpm dev --watch vant4   # from the repository root: rebuild on change, next to the designer
```
